beats.label: S1 · Allison's cleaning
beats.text: Sheriff Holston's wife Allison finds proof the outside view is faked, declares she wants to 'go out,' and dies walking into a toxic wasteland.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the central lie about the outside and the Pact rule that anyone who says 'go out' is sent out. Every later beat sits on this.

beats.label: S1 · Holston follows
beats.text: Two years later Holston investigates the death of Juliette's lover George, walks out himself, briefly sees a lush green world before dying, and names her his successor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Hands the investigation and the sheriff role to Juliette, and plants the second version of 'outside' — a lush lie the audience must remember.

beats.label: S1 · Sheriff Juliette
beats.text: Juliette takes the sheriff badge, carved 'TRUTH,' to hunt George's killer. Mayor Jahns is poisoned and Deputy Marnes murdered; Judicial's Billings becomes her deputy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Juliette in position, removes the two adults who trusted her, and installs Billings — the person she'll spend the season learning whether to trust.

beats.label: S1 · Cameras and Flamekeepers
beats.text: She uncovers hidden cameras behind the Silo's mirrors and a secret group, the Flamekeepers, who preserve the past. She retrieves George's forbidden hard drive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment the conspiracy stops being rumour and becomes physical evidence in Juliette's hands. Everything after is the fight over that hard drive.

beats.label: S1 · Bernard revealed
beats.text: IT head Bernard reveals he is the Silo's true ruler, admits ordering Jahns and Marnes killed, seizes the drive, and falsely declares Juliette wants to 'go out.'
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the antagonist and locks in the mechanism that sends Juliette outside — she isn't caught, she's forcibly written into the cleaning ritual.

beats.label: S1 · The green lie exposed
beats.text: Juliette escapes, accesses the drive, and watches a past cleaning showing lush greenery outside. Her broadcast of the truth is cut off before the Silo can see it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms the outside footage is fabricated in the helmets themselves, and shows the Silo population never learns — critical for how season 2 opens inside.

beats.label: S1 · Over the ridge
beats.text: Sent out to clean, Juliette's helmet shows the same fake green view — but her suit holds. She survives and sees dozens of other silos ringing a ruined city on the horizon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The final image and the premise of the next season: Juliette alive outside, and the world is not one silo but many.

cliffhanger.text: Juliette has walked out of her Silo, survived the poisoned air, and climbed over the crater rim to find dozens of other silos and a ruined city on the horizon. Inside her Silo, Bernard believes she is dead and the truth is buried.
questions: Are the other silos inhabited, and do any of them know about each other?
Who or what is Bernard actually serving, and how far up does the deception go?
What happened to the world outside, and why has every generation been lied to about it?

characters.name: Juliette Nichols
characters.line: Engineer turned sheriff who just survived her own cleaning; last seen walking away from her Silo toward a ruined city, unaware anyone inside might learn she lived.

characters.name: Bernard Holland
characters.line: Head of IT and the Silo's true ruler; ordered the murders of Jahns and Marnes, has the hard drive, and believes he has finally silenced Juliette.

characters.name: Robert Sims
characters.line: Bernard's Judicial enforcer, running the hidden camera network and cleaning up anyone — including his own people — who gets close to the secret.

characters.name: Paul Billings
characters.line: Juliette's deputy, secretly carrying the disqualifying 'Syndrome'; now positioned to be made sheriff in her place under Bernard's protection.
characters.note: Kept one page of the children's book after burning the rest — sympathies unclear.

characters.name: Lukas Kyle
characters.line: The cafeteria stargazer who grew close to Juliette; sentenced by Bernard to the mines for helping her with the hard drive.
characters.note: Knows enough to be dangerous to Bernard if he ever gets out.

characters.name: Martha Walker
characters.line: Juliette's agoraphobic mentor in Mechanical who quietly swapped the heat tape on Juliette's suit — the single act that kept her alive on the way out.

beats.label: S2 · Into Silo 17
beats.text: Juliette survives her cleaning and crosses into abandoned Silo 17, where a man locked in the vault, Solo, tells her fifty silos exist.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Anchors the whole season geographically and delivers the scope revelation (50 silos) that reframes everything.

beats.label: S2 · Bernard clamps down
beats.text: In Silo 18, Bernard hides that Juliette lived, imposes a curfew, and jails Walker to smother the unrest her defiance is sparking in Mechanical.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why the lower levels are already primed for revolt before anything else happens.

beats.label: S2 · Meadows framed
beats.text: Meadows demands to be sent outside; Bernard poisons her and frames Knox and Shirley for the murder, pushing Mechanical into open revolt.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The ignition point of the civil war that occupies the rest of the season.

beats.label: S2 · Lukas and the Legacy
beats.text: Bernard makes Lukas his shadow to decode a 140-year-old letter; Lukas finds the Legacy vault, the fifty silos, and a hidden 'safeguard'.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Lukas as the second POV into the silo's true history and seeds the 'safeguard' that pays off at the end.

beats.label: S2 · Solo's silo
beats.text: Juliette fixes Solo's flooded pump, discovers five young survivors he had lied about, and learns the safeguard is a poison line that can kill everyone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Silo 17 group Juliette is now bound to and defines the doomsday stakes.

beats.label: S2 · The rebellion wins
beats.text: Rebels feed Bernard lies through his own camera and seize the lower floors; Lukas resigns as his shadow after learning the truth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Bernard's regime collapses and Lukas exits the seat of power, leaving a leadership vacuum going into s3.

beats.label: S2 · Incinerator
beats.text: Juliette returns to Silo 18 in a firefighter suit; she and Bernard are locked in the incinerator as a flashback drops to Washington and a dirty-bomb crisis.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The literal cliffhanger plus the first crack in the origin mystery — this is the state s3 opens in.

cliffhanger.text: Juliette has walked back into a Silo 18 mid-revolution and is locked with Bernard inside the firing incinerator, while a flashback to Washington opens a door onto how the silos began.
questions: Can Juliette or Bernard survive the incinerator?
With Lukas gone and Mechanical holding the lower floors, who actually runs Silo 18 now?
What does the Washington, D.C. dirty-bomb flashback have to do with the silos?

characters.name: Juliette Nichols
characters.line: Engineer-turned-sheriff who survived her cleaning; back inside Silo 18 in a firefighter suit and locked in the incinerator with Bernard.

characters.name: Bernard Holland
characters.line: Silo 18's mayor and head of IT; his cover-ups have collapsed and he is trapped in the incinerator with the woman he tried to kill.

characters.name: Lukas Kyle
characters.line: Bernard's former shadow, who decoded Quinn's letter, saw the Legacy and the fifty silos, and resigned rather than inherit the lie.

characters.name: Solo (Jimmy)
characters.line: The lone adult who has lived inside Silo 17's vault since the rebellion of his childhood, now allied with Juliette and the five young survivors.

characters.name: Knox
characters.line: Head of Mechanical and de facto leader of the rebellion; has broken Bernard's blockade and pushed the fight ten floors up.

characters.name: Robert Sims
characters.line: Former head of Judicial Security, promoted to Bernard's IT shadow at the last moment; his wife Camille is the one the Legacy accepted, not him.
